about.description: Video calls, voice chat, gifts, games, and a creator economy — all in one anonymous social platform

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: Caakus connects people from all over the world through real-time video, voice, and chat. We build bridges between cultures, languages, and continents — letting everyone express themselves freely while earning Yuyu, sending gifts, climbing leaderboards, and even monetizing their social presence. Whether you want a quick anonymous conversation or a thriving creator career, Caakus is built for you.
mission.body1: At Caakus, we believe that genuine human connection should be rewarded. We're revolutionizing social networking by creating the first platform where every conversation, every video call, and every social interaction generates real economic value for users.
mission.body2: Our mission is to democratize access to cryptocurrency earnings while fostering authentic global connections. Whether you're a student in Tokyo, an entrepreneur in Lagos, or a retiree in Paris—everyone deserves to earn from their social interactions.

authenticity.title: Authenticity First
authenticity.body: We prioritize genuine human connections over artificial engagement. No bots, no fake profiles, no manufactured interactions—just real people having real conversations.

privacy.title: Privacy Matters
privacy.body: Your privacy is sacred. We operate with complete anonymity—no email, no phone number, no personal data collection. Connect freely without compromising your identity.

fairness.title: Fair Economics
fairness.body: Users receive 50% of gift values, 92% of challenge pots, and 100% ownership of their earnings. We believe in fair value distribution and transparent economics.

vision.title: Our Vision for the Future
vision.body: We envision a world where social media platforms reward users fairly for their attention and engagement. Caakus is pioneering the shift from extractive social networks that profit from user data, to generative platforms that create value for everyone. By 2026, we aim to have paid out over $100 million in cryptocurrency earnings to our global community, proving that social connection and economic opportunity can coexist beautifully.

anonymous.title: Anonymous & Secure
anonymous.body: Your identity remains protected. Video call, voice chat, or text — all without compromising your privacy.

multilanguage.title: Multi-language
multilanguage.body: Over 11 languages available so you can video chat and connect with the whole world without barriers.

instant.title: Instant Connection
instant.body: Match with someone for a video or voice call in under 1 second. No waiting, no friction.

hdVideo.title: HD Video & Voice Calls
hdVideo.body: Experience crystal-clear 1080p HD video quality with professional-grade audio. Our advanced WebRTC technology ensures smooth, lag-free communication even on slower connections. Adaptive bitrate streaming automatically adjusts quality for optimal performance.

matching.title: Lightning-Fast Matching
matching.body: Get connected in under 3 seconds with our proprietary matching algorithm. No waiting rooms, no queues, no delays. Our three-level matching system uses pre-fetching and smart routing to ensure instant connections worldwide.

crypto.title: Earn Cryptocurrency
crypto.body: Get paid in Yuyu for every interaction. Receive gifts during calls (keep 50%), win video challenges (keep 92%), complete daily achievements, and build streaks for bonus multipliers. Your earnings are 100% yours—withdraw anytime.

anonymousFull.title: 100% Anonymous
anonymousFull.body: Use Caakus immediately without any registration. No email, no phone number, no personal information required. All conversations are encrypted end-to-end using military-grade AES-256 encryption. Your identity is never shared.

globalReach.title: 150+ Countries
globalReach.body: Connect with people across every continent. Platform available in 11+ languages with smart language matching. Practice new languages with native speakers or chat in your preferred language. True global connectivity.

gifts.title: Virtual Gifts
gifts.body: Send and receive virtual gifts worth real cryptocurrency during conversations. Gift recipients keep 50% of the value in Yuyu. Turn good vibes into real earnings. Over 50 unique gift options available.

story.p1: Caakus was founded in 2025 by Bryan Lewis Dongue Ndiffo, a 22-year-old technology entrepreneur from Worms, Germany. Born on November 18, 2003, Bryan graduated with deep expertise in blockchain technology, fintech, and social platform engineering.
story.p2: The idea for Caakus emerged from a simple observation: billions of people spend hours daily on social media platforms, generating enormous value for tech giants through their attention and engagement—yet receiving nothing in return. Bryan envisioned a fundamentally different model where users would be direct beneficiaries of the economic value they create.
story.p3: What makes Caakus revolutionary isn't just the cryptocurrency rewards—it's the recognition that authentic human connection has inherent value that should be shared with those creating it. Every conversation on Caakus represents a moment of genuine human interaction, and we believe that deserves to be rewarded.

timeline4.title: Global Expansion

timeline5.title: The Future
timeline5.desc: Our roadmap includes AI-powered translation, AR/VR integration, decentralized governance, and expansion to 200+ countries. Goal: $100M+ paid to users and becoming the #1 social earning platform globally.

story.philosophyPoint2: Economic value flows directly to those creating it
story.philosophyPoint3: Technology serves humanity, not the other way around

story.philosophyPoint5: Financial inclusion is a right, not a privilege

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What makes Caakus different from other social platforms?
faq.a1p1: Caakus is the world's first platform where users earn cryptocurrency (Yuyu) for authentic social interactions. Unlike Instagram, TikTok, or Snapchat where platforms profit from your data and attention while you get nothing, Caakus shares economic value directly with users.
faq.a1p2: We also prioritize complete anonymity—no email, no phone number, no personal data collection—while still enabling cryptocurrency rewards through blockchain integration.
faq.q2: How do I start earning on Caakus?
faq.a2Intro: Start earning immediately in multiple ways:
faq.a2GiftsDesc: Receive gifts during calls—you keep 50% of the value in Yuyu
faq.a2ChallengesDesc: Win competitions and keep 92% of the prize pot
faq.a2AchievementsDesc: Complete tasks like "First Call Today" or "5 Conversations"
faq.a2ReferralDesc: Earn $5 per friend who signs up plus 20% recurring commission
faq.a2StreaksDesc: Consecutive days increase earnings (30-day streak = 2x multiplier)
faq.q3: Is Caakus really free to use?
faq.a3: Yes! Caakus is completely free. You can start video chatting, voice calling, and earning Yuyu immediately without paying anything. We offer optional premium subscriptions ($9.99/month) that unlock exclusive features like unlimited matches, priority support, advanced filters, and higher earning rates—but the core platform is 100% free forever.
faq.q4: What is Yuyu and how does it work?
faq.a4p1: Yuyu is Caakus's native cryptocurrency built on Coinbase BASE Layer 2 blockchain (ERC-20 token). It has a unique deflationary model where 1% of all transactions are automatically burned, creating scarcity and driving long-term value appreciation.
faq.a4p2: You can use Yuyu to: send virtual gifts, participate in challenges, unlock premium features, or withdraw to your cryptocurrency wallet and trade on exchanges for other cryptos or fiat currency.
faq.q5: Can I withdraw my Yuyu earnings?
faq.a5: Absolutely! Your earnings are 100% yours. Withdraw them to your cryptocurrency wallet anytime. Since Yuyu is on Coinbase BASE Layer 2, you can swap it for ETH, USDC, or convert to fiat through exchanges. There's a small network fee for withdrawals to cover blockchain transaction costs, and minimum withdrawal amounts apply.
faq.q6: How does Caakus ensure user safety?
faq.a6Intro: Safety is our top priority. We implement multiple layers of protection:
faq.a6Item1: End-to-end AES-256 encryption on all communications
faq.a6Item2: Automated content moderation and AI-powered detection
faq.a6Item4: Ability to block and report inappropriate behavior immediately
faq.a6Item5: GDPR, CCPA compliance and 18+ age requirement
faq.a7: Caakus supports 11+ languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, and Russian. Our smart matching algorithm can connect you with native speakers for language practice, or match you with people who speak your preferred language. The entire platform interface adapts to your selected language.
faq.a8: Caakus was founded by Bryan Lewis Dongue Ndiffo, a 22-year-old technology entrepreneur based in Worms, Germany. Born November 18, 2003, Bryan has expertise in blockchain, fintech, and social platforms. He created Yuyu cryptocurrency and pioneered the concept of social finance where genuine human interaction creates measurable economic value.

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.content: At Caakus, we take your privacy very seriously. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal information when you use our real-time video, voice, and social communication platform.

use.title: 3. Use of Information
use.content: We use your information to provide, improve, and personalize our services, connect you with other users, and ensure the security of the platform.

sharing.title: 4. Sharing of Information
sharing.content: We never sell your information. We only share it with your consent, with service providers, or when required by law.

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, modification, disclosure, or destruction. This includes data encryption, secure authentication, and strict access controls.

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
retention.content: Video and audio conversations are not recorded. We retain your personal data as long as necessary for our services and legal obligations.

rights.title: 7. Your Rights
rights.content: In accordance with the GDPR and applicable data protection laws, you have the right to:
items: Delete your information (right to be forgotten)
Restrict the processing of your data
Object to the processing of your data
Receive your data in a portable format
Withdraw your consent at any time

cookies.title: 8. Cookies
cookies.content: We use cookies to enhance your experience. You can manage your preferences in your browser settings.
cookies.additionalContent: Additionally, third-party vendors including Google may use cookies to serve ads and collect analytics data. You can manage cookie preferences in your browser settings.

minors.title: 9. Protection of Minors
minors.content: Our service is intended for users aged 13 and over. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13 years old.

moderation.title: 10. Content Moderation & User Safety
moderation.content: Since Caakus provides anonymous voice and chat communication, we maintain strict moderation to ensure the safety and privacy of our users. Conversations are not publicly visible, and any misuse, harassment, or inappropriate behavior can be reported to our team via the Contact section below. We do not allow adult content, hate speech, or any form of abuse.

advertising.title: Advertising and Google AdSense
advertising.content: Our website displays ads served by Google AdSense. Google uses cookies to serve ads based on a user's previous visits to our website or other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to users based on their visit to this site and/or other sites on the Internet.
